name: Momentic
long_description:
Momentic makes Mo, the AI QA engineer. Point Mo at your app with a goal and a swarm of agents bug-bashes it the way your team would, then reports every bug with repro steps, logs, and a video replay.

Notion, Whatnot, Retool, Webflow, Framer, and 1,600+ teams use Momentic.

Teams also use Momentic to write end-to-end tests in plain English, run them in CI, and let agents triage and maintain the suite across web and mobile.

Learn more at momentic.ai

launches.title: Momentic: Mo, the AI QA engineer that finds bugs before your users do
launches.tagline: Point Mo at your app. Get back the bug report, with repro steps, logs, and a video replay of each one.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Mo is an AI QA engineer. Give it any app (web, iOS, or Android) and a goal, and it launches hundreds of agents that bug-bash every nook and cranny of your app the way your team would before a release. You get one report: what was tested, what failed, repro steps, logs, and a video replay of each bug. We’re giving every sign up $250 in free credits at [momentic.ai](http://momentic.ai).

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/5RMQVtk-ayE>

**Hey YC, we're Wei-Wei and Jeff.** We launched Momentic here in YC W24 as AI-powered end-to-end testing, and teams like Notion, Whatnot, and Retool run their test suites on it today. Today we're launching Mo.

**The problem**

Claude Code, Cursor, and Devin made writing code super easy. Testing is still the bottleneck. Over the past two years, our customers kept telling us: "I don't want another script to write and maintain" and "Now I'm paying double, for QA and for a testing tool we have to use." No one asked for another testing framework to learn. All they wanted was no bugs.

**How Mo works**

1. Point Mo at your app and tell it what to test, in plain English: "bug bash the checkout flow."
2. Mo launches hundreds of agents in parallel on our hosted browsers and emulators/simulators. They click through the app just like a QA engineer would and cover every edge case, every nook and cranny.
3. Every bug report has repro steps, logs, screenshots, and a video replay. File a ticket or hand it to your coding agent to fix.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117199&key=user_uploads/1327081/d363fb1e-977d-4c17-84dd-c3b9a8fcc89f)

Here's one from this week. Mo hit Search on GitHub's Pull requests page without touching the prefilled query; GitHub wiped the query and threw an empty-query error. One prompt: "bug bash" plus the URL.

**Results so far**

Notion, Glide, Superpower and other teams put Mo on their own apps. Across the beta: Mo ran 1,100+ bug bashes and caught 3,500 verified bugs. One customer told us: "I reviewed the findings and merged fixes for 10 of them. How did we not catch this already?"

In our evals, Mo found 3.8x more bugs than Codex with Playwright MCP, 9x more bugs per hour, at half the cost per bug.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117199&key=user_uploads/1327081/a08dc6e5-a978-457b-9e88-d5ebce725be1)

**Why we built it**

We started Momentic because we hated testing. At Nashi, I spent four hours every Thursday evening manually testing before a release. Two years of selling Momentic taught us that teams don't want better scripts; they want no bugs, so we built Mo to find them.

**Our ask**

* Try it on your app: [momentic.ai](http://momentic.ai), $250 in free credits on signup.
* YC founders: we have a [sick YC deal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/deals/2562) to redeem on Bookface.
* Questions or a bug you want us to look at: DM me on X [@wuweiweiwu](https://x.com/wuweiweiwu).

Wei-Wei and Jeff

launches.title: Momentic - Automated testing with AI
launches.tagline: Use AI to automate the most tedious parts of software development.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We’re Wei-Wei and Jeff and we're building [Momentic](https://momentic.ai). We're on a mission to make testing easy and fast for developers.

# **TL;DR**

Developers author E2E tests 10X faster with Momentic’s low-code editor. We make AI do the heavy lifting for you: finding elements, reasoning about assertions, visual comparisons, and even generating whole test cases!

# **Testing still sucks!**

The average developer today still spends hundreds of hours every year writing and maintaining test suites in Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright. Existing no-code solutions like Browserstack and Tricentis are often unreliable and difficult to use, forcing teams to fallback on manual QA.

The bottom line is: **testing slows you down**, and all companies eventually encounter a tradeoff between velocity and quality.

# **What if testing could help developers ship _faster_?**

Our low-code test editor replaces traditional test scripts with AI-powered, self-healing steps. It seamlessly integrates into your existing workflows: from local development to CI/CD environments and production.

Here’s how it works:

_Interact with your app in plain English._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79067&key=user_uploads/1327081/d3261cce-cd3a-4f9c-bc55-0cea1533260f)

_Craft assertions from any logical statement or visual condition._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79067&key=user_uploads/1327081/9a4fdfe4-f7d8-4183-a4a1-7b09ade815ac)

_Record and replay actions on any site, even those on localhost._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79067&key=user_uploads/1327081/25e50c1d-dd84-4e7f-aafa-00e33618b42e)

# **Meet the team**

We’re [Wei-Wei](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hungweiwu/) and [Jeff](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeff-an/) - two software engineers who dreaded testing so much we founded a company to do it for us 😂.

We-Wei was a founding engineer at Nashi and then a staff engineer at Density, leading product engineering and product reliability. Jeff led testing at Robinhood and enterprise quality at Retool, and saw first-hand how lack of testing can impact a company’s bottom line.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79067&key=user_uploads/1327081/d66b58e4-4dfa-45f9-89c9-d2cfa4b9bc95)

# **Our ask**

Momentic is currently in private beta, working closely with early customers. We plan to give access to a select few companies in the next few weeks, so please reach out to [founders@momentic.ai](mailto:founders@momentic.ai) or [book a call](https://momentic.ai/demo).

We would love to work with you if:

1. You want to use Momentic to accelerate development teams without sacrificing quality.
2. You currently spend more time and resources than you’d like on testing.

We offer plans for teams of all sizes and offer features such as white-glove onboarding, accessibility audits, visual diffing, environments, source control, custom SSO, and migrations from existing frameworks.

For more details, visit [momentic.ai](http://momentic.ai).

Thank you!

Wei-Wei and Jeff
